extractedBy: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), overnight run agentpack-batch8, extraction worker
notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/iconcapsule.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/iconcapsule.md at 021681d (“docs: add Icon Capsule guide”); both are unchanged since. The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 28 October 2026 on the installed build itself (jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02, Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October), so items citing them carry 2026-10-28 and 0.1.78-dbe0e02. Installed IconCapsule.tsx and Icon.tsx match every guide and evidence sentence used here, read from source, not run: iconName defaults to ic_card and accessibilityRole to image (IconCapsule.tsx:81-92); the capsule merges a JFSThemeProvider's modes under its own (93-103); it reads seven iconCapsule tokens and no glass token, and the radius sentinel 9999 makes it a circle (32-58); the root View renders accessibilityLabel undefined and the Icon inside is hidden from accessibility (112-127); Icon draws the registry glyph first and the source only when the name is missing or unknown, and an unknown name with no source warns and draws nothing, so the circle is empty (Icon.tsx:86-138); the registry has 1,323 names, including every name the guide uses (ic_wallet, ic_bulb, ic_water, ic_mobile, ic_savings, ic_card, ic_confirm, ic_warning, ic_error), and not “wallet”. Token values looked up with the package's own getVariableByName: Icon Capsule Size XS 18/12, S 29/18, M 42/18, L 81/36; Context Nudge&Alert 14/14 and CTACard 58/29 at every size, Default and ListItem follow the size; Emphasis High Primary #cea15a with a #0f0d0a glyph, Secondary #5d00b5, Neutral #303338 and Tertiary #036b99 with white; Medium Primary #fde8c9 and Secondary #e4dbff with a coloured glyph, Neutral #545961 with a white glyph, Tertiary still #036b99 with a pale #b3d3e0 glyph; Low a transparent fill with the coloured glyph; System positive #26ab21, warning #f06e0f, negative #f50030 with a white glyph, unchanged by Emphasis and AppearanceBrand; Page type JioPlus changes only Neutral Low's glyph (to white); iconCapsule/glass/background exists (#ffffff33) but is never read. ListItem passes its modes plus Context ListItem to its leading slot and adds no AppearanceBrand (ListItem.tsx:117-120, 219-230, 509-522); cloneChildrenWithModes lets the child's own modes win over the parent's, forced Context last (react-utils.ts:59-65); ListGroup passes its own modes to its rows (ListGroup.tsx:469). No guide sentence is contradicted by the installed build. One reads wider than the code if taken beyond its example: Emphasis Medium's “A pale circle with a coloured icon.” is shown on Secondary (and holds for Primary), but Neutral Medium is a lighter grey with a white glyph and Tertiary Medium keeps the blue circle with a pale glyph, so the Emphasis rules keep the guide's Secondary context and the evidence fact gives the other values. The In context sentence “so set its colour on the capsule” is recorded as where a colour goes when the capsule takes one: under the building rules a slot child carries no appearance modes unless an entry's rule says the content needs it (here, a status), so it is not read as a call to colour every capsule. Not recorded: the playground readout (“Low draws no circle”: not a citable section); the evidence's “Figma draws only M; the other sizes and contexts exist as variable modes only” and the Sources note's Figma icon swap against iconName (a property mapping, not something Coin lacks: the package has all four sizes and a glyph by name); the dropped accessibilityLabel and the MDX's claim that it is supported (screen-reader matters, which the pack keeps out of gaps; kept in an accessibility rule and an evidence fact); Storybook's coverage (no story shows XS, S, L, Medium, Low, System or a Context); style, testID, aria-label pass-through, accessibilityRole and the 1 px transparent border; Color Mode, and Context values as options (the evidence's Limits; parent components set Context). Avatar, named by the guide for letters or a logo, has no entry in this pack. Anatomy: both parts are marked required: the circle always renders, and iconName defaults to ic_card, so a glyph is drawn unless the name isn't in the icon set (the Not in the icon set state, which the guide shows as a Don't). Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide's helper adds Color Mode Light to every capsule); in the In context list the ListGroup's modes and each capsule's AppearanceBrand Neutral are dropped, since slot children carry no appearance modes and a List Item doesn't set the capsule's colour, so the capsules show the package default, Primary gold, where the guide and Figma show Neutral (the default-appearance gap, #419); the failure capsule keeps Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative, because the guide's Do pair and its configuration say a failure needs it (the building rules' status case). ListGroup and ListItem have entries (ListItem's is undocumented). This matches the ActionTile entry, which puts a mode-free IconCapsule with an iconName from the icon set in the tile's icon slot. Copy is the guide's own (Pay bills; Electricity, Adani Electricity; Water, BWSSB; Mobile recharge, Jio prepaid; ic_bulb, ic_water, ic_mobile, ic_error, ic_wallet); press handlers are stubs. Left out of examples (the pack allows three): the size, appearance and emphasis specimens, positive and warning, the unknown-name state, the Don'ts and the playground. Gaps: Glass, the default appearance and the unreachable source, all on Component Bug #419 (Component Fix › To do, Mr. Biscuit). Sorting (batch 8): the cross-check found that the Emphasis High, Medium and Low items presented “on AppearanceBrand Secondary” as the guide’s own condition; they now give the guide’s captions and say that the guide shows them on Secondary (the evidence fact gives Medium on Neutral and Tertiary, where the caption does not hold; a guide fix covers it). It also found Circle and Icon marked always present, where Emphasis Low draws no circle and an iconName outside the set leaves the circle empty; both are now not required.

evidenceFacts.name: iconName
evidenceFacts.description: Any name in the Coin icon set (about 1,300). An unknown name draws the circle with no glyph and logs a warning.
evidenceFacts.quote: any name in the Coin icon set (about 1,300). An unknown name draws the circle with no glyph and logs a warning.

evidenceFacts.name: source
evidenceFacts.description: A fallback glyph (SVG, raster or element), used only when iconName isn't in the icon set. Because iconName defaults to ic_card, source alone never shows: with no iconName the capsule draws ic_card; with an empty or unknown iconName it draws the source.
evidenceFacts.quote: Because `iconName` defaults to `ic_card`, `source` alone never shows

evidenceFacts.name: accessibilityLabel
evidenceFacts.description: Accepted and discarded: the capsule is an image with no name, and its glyph is hidden from screen readers.

evidenceFacts.name: modes
evidenceFacts.description: Merged over a JFSThemeProvider's modes; the capsule's own modes win.

evidenceFacts.name: Icon Capsule Size
evidenceFacts.description: Circle and glyph: XS 18 / 12 px, S 29 / 18, M 42 / 18 (the default), L 81 / 36.
evidenceFacts.quote: `Icon Capsule Size`: XS 18 / 12, S 29 / 18, M 42 / 18 (default), L 81 / 36 (circle / glyph, rendered).

evidenceFacts.name: Context
evidenceFacts.description: Default and ListItem use Icon Capsule Size; Nudge&Alert fixes the capsule at 14 px with a 14 px glyph, CTACard at 58 px with a 29 px glyph. Parent components set it.
evidenceFacts.quote: `Context`: Default and ListItem use the size; Nudge&Alert fixes 14 / 14; CTACard 58 / 29 (rendered). Parent components set it.

evidenceFacts.quote: Medium: Primary `#fde8c9`, Secondary `#e4dbff`, Neutral `#545961`, Tertiary `#036b99` with a pale `#b3d3e0` glyph.

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceSystem

gaps.text: Figma's Icon Capsule has a Type property, Default or Glass; the package has no type prop and never reads the iconCapsule/glass/background token, so there is no Glass capsule in code (Component Bug #419).
gaps.quote: Figma has `Type=Glass`; the package has no type prop and never reads `iconCapsule/glass/background`.

gaps.text: Figma's default Icon Capsule is Neutral High (dark grey, white glyph); the package with no modes, and Storybook's Default, are Primary High (gold, black glyph) (Component Bug #419).
gaps.quote: Figma's Default is Neutral High (dark grey, white glyph); the package with no modes, and Storybook's Default, are Primary High (gold, black glyph).

gaps.text: The JSDoc and Biscuit's IconCapsule.mdx say source is used when iconName is missing, but iconName defaults to ic_card, so source never shows on its own: only with an empty or unknown iconName (Component Bug #419).
gaps.quote: JSDoc and MDX say `source` is used when `iconName` is missing; the default `iconName` means it never is.
